fire: The janitor rinsed the mops behind the school gym.
Our grandmother baked peach cobbler every Sunday in August.
Workers stretched tarpaulins across the broken roof of the barn.
The treaty rests on old covenants between the two clans.
A huge zeppelin drifted slowly above the coastal town.
Tourists buy painted clogs from the stalls near the canal.
Her uncle played two zithers at the village wedding.
Sailors hauled down both jibs as the squall came in.
